questions.text: Views are stored in which directory by default?
questions.explanation: Views live in resources/views.

questions.text: What templating language does Laravel typically use for views?
questions.explanation: Blade is Laravel's templating language.

questions.text: What file extension identifies a Blade template?
questions.explanation: Blade templates use the .blade.php extension.

questions.text: Which Artisan command creates a new view file?
questions.explanation: php artisan make:view greeting creates a new view.

questions.text: Which global helper function returns a view from a route or controller?
questions.explanation: The view() helper returns a view.

questions.text: Which Blade directive lets you embed a block of plain PHP code in a template?
questions.explanation: @php ... @endphp embeds raw PHP.

questions.text: How do you display the value of a variable in a Blade template?
questions.explanation: Blade uses double curly braces, e.g. {{ $name }}.

questions.text: Which set of directives is used to construct if statements in Blade?
questions.explanation: @if, @elseif, @else, and @endif build conditional logic in Blade.

questions.text: Which directive begins a switch statement in Blade?
questions.explanation: @switch begins a switch statement (with @case, @break, @default, @endswitch).

questions.text: Which directive is used to loop over a collection, such as a list of users, in Blade?
questions.explanation: @foreach ... @endforeach iterates over a collection.

questions.text: How do you write a Blade comment that will NOT appear in the rendered HTML?
questions.explanation: {{-- comment --}} is a Blade comment — unlike HTML comments, it's stripped from the output.

questions.text: Which Blade directive generates a hidden CSRF token field inside a form?
questions.explanation: @csrf outputs the hidden CSRF token field.

questions.text: Which Blade directive lets an HTML form spoof a PUT, PATCH, or DELETE request?
questions.explanation: @method('PUT') creates the hidden _method field.

questions.text: By default, where are Laravel controllers stored?
questions.explanation: Controllers are stored in app/Http/Controllers by default.

questions.text: Complete the Artisan command that generates a new controller:
questions.explanation: php artisan make:controller UserController generates a new controller class.

questions.text: Complete the Blade echo statement so it displays the $name variable passed to the view:
questions.explanation: {{ $name }} echoes the $name variable.

questions.text: Complete the loop so it displays each user's name property:
questions.explanation: $user->name accesses the user's name property.

questions.text: Complete the RESTful controller method name used to permanently remove a resource:
questions.explanation: destroy($id) is the conventional method for deleting a resource.

Remove the specified resource from storage
Display a listing of all resources
Validate input and save a newly created resource
